column6: Create a pivot table for each of the following:
1. Show the sum of the amout per vendor, grouped by store.
2. Show the sum of the amout per store grouped by date (year and month)
3. Show the sum of the amout by store, grouped by date (year and month) and use slice (segmentation) by vendor
4. Show the average sales per vendor grouped by store. Insert a time line.
5. Show the sum of sales per vendor grouped by store. Insert a calculated field where a 10% discount on the amount of sales is calculated.
